apply_mp_style_corrections: apply Materials Project style energy corrections to an ASE Atoms object using OMat24 or MP2020 correction type
generate_computed_structure_entry: create a ComputedStructureEntry from a pymatgen structure and energy with MP2020 or OMat24 corrections applied
generate_cse_parameters: generate parameters dict for a ComputedStructureEntry from a VASP input set including hubbards and potcar info
create_OMat24Compatibility: create an OMat24Compatibility instance with Advanced GGA/GGA+U mixing scheme and custom config file for processing entries
process_entry_with_OMat24Compatibility: process a ComputedStructureEntry using OMat24Compatibility to apply energy corrections and clean the entry in place
